name: Korean peninsula
summary: North Korea fired several missiles on 4 Nov, its fourth launch in a month; none found since
state: South Korea said North Korea fired multiple missiles on 4 Nov, its fourth weapons launch in a month (The Star). North Korea said on 5 Nov it had tested a new air defence system and a long-range cruise missile (Stars and Stripes). Searches on 11 Nov found no later launch, nuclear test or ICBM overflight of Japan; launches within two weeks keep Watch.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice for South Korea and Japan; launches rarely disrupt daily life there.
